findings.problem: The tool guard walks only the Java object graph through Map and Iterable. Keys inside a JsonNode/ObjectNode value (Iterable over values only), Object[] arrays and POJO/record values are never inspected, but they are still serialized into the payload. For example, body.put("text", someObjectNodeWithWebSearchOptions) would pass the guard. The spec (Behaviour FR-19) says this guard 'cannot be bypassed by callers'. All current callers build plain Maps, so this cannot be reached today. It is a defense-in-depth gap only.
findings.fix: Run the check on the serialized form: walk json.readTree(payload) after writeValueAsString (top-level tools/tool_choice, any field name starting with web_search at any depth) before beforeSend/send.

findings.problem: The new getStructuredScenario description lists 'FAILED INVALID_SCENARIO' as a 409 SCENARIO_NOT_READY case without qualification. Take the path of IT #13: SCHEMA_CORRECTION parses SC-BAD, the guard FAILs, and GUARD_REGENERATION returns invalid output. The run ends FAILED INVALID_SCENARIO, yet an earlier parsed attempt exists, so ReasoningController returns 200 with that scenario (accepted false). The code follows the spec table row '>= 1 parsed attempt (any run status) -> 200', so the contract text is the inaccurate side.
findings.fix: Change the description (and the matching spec row) to 'FAILED INVALID_SCENARIO without any parsed attempt'. Optionally assert the #13 record status in StructuredScenarioIT.

findings.problem: These ReasoningPipeline paths have no tests: (a) the run deadline passing during or before a SCENARIO_GENERATION call. Expected: CallAbandonedException/Stop, RUN_TIMEOUT, stage kept, no scenario_attempt row, no further calls. (b) model_call.response_status for failed calls (429 should store 429, 500 twice should store 500, a timeout should store null). The code looks right, but the abandon semantics and the status recording rely only on review.
findings.fix: Add an IT that sets a short run deadline with a slow stub answer and asserts RUN_TIMEOUT, stageIndex 7 and 0 attempt rows. Extend #15 to assert model_call.response_status (429 / 500 / 401).

findings.problem: For EMPTY_PACK the loop starts at index 6 (EXPLORING_FUTURES). Stage 7 is committed a second time and gets a placeholder-stage-delay pause, and ReasoningPipeline returns before waiting the min-stage-duration remainder of stage 7. The spec (pipeline step 2) says only stages 8-10 are placeholders. This only affects timing.
findings.fix: Wait remainder(started) before returning EMPTY_PACK and start the executor loop at index 7 for EMPTY_PACK.

findings.problem: finalStatus.accept runs in a finally block. If the consumer throws (the model_call status UPDATE fails), that exception replaces an in-flight ChatGptCallException or CallAbandonedException. The run then ends INTERNAL_ERROR instead of CHATGPT_RATE_LIMITED, CHATGPT_UNAVAILABLE, SESSION_EXPIRED or RUN_TIMEOUT.
findings.fix: Wrap finalStatus.accept in try/catch(RuntimeException) and log it (no body), or record the status in ReasoningPipeline after the call returns or throws.
